scope: Independent cached witness and observable descriptor review only; no feature-optimum search, classifier fitting, selection change, solver, rho or truth-label outcome analysis.
method: Aggregate all original same-name aliases in foreground float64 directly, normalize complete molecular maps, reconstruct each saved 1/2-donor unit-coefficient witness and compare its squared residual. Check complete eligible donor counts and full membership without searching for a better donor.
limitations: This validates the saved witnesses and their membership, not global optimality over every possible donor pair.
No structural identity or FDR conclusion follows from these observable-only correlations.
Two previously exposed development cases remain development evidence; models and cutoffs were not modified.
Zero-map U=1 values are placeholders, not spatial uniqueness; none of these maps may become model input.
